build.command: git clone --depth=1 --branch v2.1-agentzh-loongarch64 https://github.com/loongson/luajit2.git luajit2-loongarch64 && make -C luajit2-loongarch64 clean && make -C luajit2-loongarch64 -j$(nproc) XCFLAGS="-DLUAJIT_NUMMODE=2 -DLUAJIT_ENABLE_LUA52COMPAT" && rm -rf /tmp/loongson-luajit-stage && make -C luajit2-loongarch64 install PREFIX=/tmp/loongson-luajit-stage

tests.command: git clone --depth=1 --branch v2.1-agentzh-loongarch64 https://github.com/loongson/luajit2.git luajit2-loongarch64 && make -C luajit2-loongarch64 clean && make -C luajit2-loongarch64 -j$(nproc) XCFLAGS='-DLUAJIT_NUMMODE=2 -DLUAJIT_ENABLE_LUA52COMPAT' && rm -rf /tmp/loongson-luajit-stage && make -C luajit2-loongarch64 install PREFIX=/tmp/loongson-luajit-stage && LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/loongson-luajit-stage/lib /tmp/loongson-luajit-stage/bin/luajit -v && LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/loongson-luajit-stage/lib /tmp/loongson-luajit-stage/bin/luajit -e 'print(jit.arch, jit.version); local s=0; for i=1,1000000 do s=s+i end; print(s)'

set -e; git -C sources/deps/luajit2-loongarch64 rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD; git -C sources/deps/luajit2-loongarch64 rev-parse HEAD; LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/local/openresty/luajit/lib /usr/local/openresty/luajit/bin/luajit -e 'print(jit.arch, jit.version); local s=0; for i=1,1000000 do s=s+i end; print(s)'; ldd /usr/local/openresty/nginx/sbin/nginx | grep -i luajit; /usr/local/openresty/bin/openresty -t; /usr/local/openresty/bin/openresty -V 2>&1 | grep -q -- '--with-pcre-jit' && { echo 'ERROR: PCRE JIT enabled'; exit 1; } || echo 'Nginx PCRE JIT flag is absent'

required_files: Loongson LuaJIT source checkout at the resolved commit
